//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Sleep Sooner -> Config

Enable Sleep Sooner.//: Whether Sleep Sooner is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

enablePreSleepMessage.//: Allows you to disable/enable the message you receive before sleeping. You still need to click the bed twice if the current time is below 12540.

whenSleepIsPossibleInTicks.//: The default time in ticks when you can sleep is ~12540. The default Sleep Sooner mod value is 12000. min: 0, max: 24,000
